page.layout: One narrow column of short entries down the left side of the scan, with blank space below each entry. Above it: page number 310. No running head, catchword or signature on this part.; One column of consul lists, each group of names set beside one year in a right-hand column; running head above the list; catchword alone at the lower right.

p.i: Mauritius Princeps Auraicus Imperator exercituū federati Belgij moritur 13. April. 1625.
Petrus Hayn Argonauta classem Beticam aureo vellere unit[?].
Occubit ad Ru-remundum Ernestus Casimirus Comes Nassau: Gubernator, cui[?] infestus filius Henricus 28. Feb. 1633.

page.notes: Printed page 310 at the top. The entries are set in a narrow italic column and may be marginal annotations, but they are transcribed here as the column they stand in. The first entry's "exercituū" and the "unit" of the Hayn entry are doubtful, as is "cui" in the last entry. The stray mark above "Mors D. Nicolai" is not a letter and is not transcribed. The years are printed beside each group, not beside each line; they are attached to the first name of their group. The year 1630 is printed with a worn final figure and may read 163o; 1632 is printed with a worn final figure and may read 163z. The catchword "Berens" is partly worn.
